_comment: EXAMPLE D6 app-auth config — PLACEHOLDERS ONLY, fail-closed default. Copy to auth.config.local.json (GIT-IGNORED via *.local.json) only AFTER the D6 admin setup exists (see docs/D6_AUTH_APP_REGISTRATION_PLAN.md). All values are REFERENCES: the tenant/client ids are entered at runtime and the certificate is referenced by a local file path — no secret, key, or token is ever placed in a config file. Validation (d6AuthConfig.js) refuses placeholders, secret-style keys, inline key material, and legacy/production-looking targets.
